newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Hestja insurer to be declared bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: Polish Hestja insurer to be declared bankrupt.

text.p: A court is likely to declare the Polish insurance company Hestja SA bankrupt on September 4 after an investor from the United States withdrew an offer to buy the firm, Hestja's administrative board member said on Monday.
Hieronim Borowczak told Reuters that U.S.' World Health Network (WHN) had decided not to bid for Hestja after Poland's Insurance Guarantee Fund refused to back the investment.
"A court will debate on declaring Hestja bankrupt on September 4 as the American WHN withrew from negotiations," he told Reuters.
WHN was ready to spend $10 million to cover Hestja's debts and raise the company's capital only if Poland's Insurance Guarantee Fund agreed to guarantee the investment.
